scripts.test: npm-run-all lint --parallel test:mocha test:karma test:ts test:flow
scripts.build: npm-run-all --silent clean transpile copy-flow-definition copy-typescript-definition strip optimize minify size
scripts.clean: rimraf dist/ devtools.js devtools.js.map debug.js debug.js.map test/ts/**/*.js
scripts.minify: uglifyjs dist/preact.js -c collapse_vars,evaluate,screw_ie8,unsafe,loops=false,keep_fargs=false,pure_getters,unused,dead_code -m -o dist/preact.min.js -p relative --in-source-map dist/preact.js.map --source-map dist/preact.min.js.map

scripts.strip:esm: jscodeshift --run-in-band -s -t config/codemod-strip-tdz.js dist/preact.mjs && jscodeshift --run-in-band -s -t config/codemod-const.js dist/preact.mjs && jscodeshift --run-in-band -s -t config/codemod-let-name.js dist/preact.mjs
